title: feature manifest, core
description: features/<name>/feature.json in any repo: the keys every feature has, whatever the repo's stack. A repo with keys of its own writes an extension that takes these by $ref, as schemas/feature.schema.json does for jstack.

$schema.description: The path from the manifest to the schema it holds to.

description.description: One sentence: what the feature does.

docs.description: Each page of the feature; the first is the one the README links.

reads.description: Each file the feature's tests read that the stack's selection cannot see, such as a page or a schema a test opens, as a glob from the repo's root in which * crosses folders: a change to a file it matches selects the feature's tests. An adapter's selection says whether it reads this list.
